name: ExternalTTS
author: LensError
description: Replaces CVR TTS and ChatBox/OSC speech using Fish Audio (API key) or a local [Kokoro-FastAPI](https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI) server, sending outgoing TTS text to your configured endpoint.
